body_rules: local git_object locator exact commit:path; use git cat-file, never dirty working-tree bytes
github_blob_api locator exact blob SHA endpoint; read preserved UTF-8 content from referenced api-body object and verify raw_sha256
unresolved/access/cycle states are data, not success

consumer_contract.map_workflow_source: join only source objects; do not derive expected jobs
consumer_contract.map_dependency_graph: consume resolved reusable-workflow edges and preserve unresolved external refs
consumer_contract.map_reconciliation: do not assert run/check presence from source objects
